Name: HelloThere
Author: jkysa88
Description:
The Muttering Farmer – NPC Friendship Reactions ExpansionDescription:

This is an expansion pack for The Muttering Farmer mod that alters how players interact with NPCs based on their friendship levels.

Currently, it includes these NPCs: Shane, Sam, Sebastian, Emily, Haley, Alex, Elliott, Leah. and Lewis, Pierre, Demetrius, Vincent (in progress), Willy.

When you meet these NPCs, speech bubbles will appear, showing different reactions depending on their friendship level with you!

The plan is to include all the Vanilla NPCs from the game. This is a beta version, so expect more NPCs and features to be added soon!

Installation:

1) Download and install The Muttering Farmer first.
   - The Muttering Farmer must be installed as its own separate mod folder in Mods.

2) Download this mod.
   - This is an i18n-only mod: it should contain only an i18n folder and a manifest.json.
   - Do NOT include or upload any files from The Muttering Farmer.

3) Folder structure (correct):
   Mods/
   ├─ TheMutteringFarmer/            (original mod)
   └─ HelloThere/                   (this mod)
      ├─ manifest.json
      └─ i18n/

4) If the download cancels:
   - This is usually a Nexus/Vortex, browser, or connection issue (not the mod).
   - Try manual download, a different browser, or temporarily disable VPN/antivirus.

Note: If you place this mod inside TheMutteringFarmer folder, it will not work correctly.

Supported Languages
English Korean
